messages:
Alex Rivera: Kicking off Luminary integration. Success targets: Day30 pilot with 75 users, <4% inference errors, SSO + audit logs validated, billing dashboard visible. Propose weekly check-ins Fridays 11am PT.
Maya Chen: Adding stakeholders: Luminary PM (Ravi), Sec lead (Giselle), Infra (Ken). Priya can intro after this thread. Key renewal signal: pilot retention >=45% by Day45.
Priya Nair: Timeline suggestion: Week0 - creds & SAML exchange; Week1 - staging + smoke; Week2 - integration tests; Week3 - canary; Week4 - pilot. I'll prepare RACI and onboarding checklist.
Sam Ortiz: Blockers to call out: VPC allowlist, model artifact access, and sample dataset schema. Also confirm whether Luminary requires logs to be forwarded to their SIEM.
Maya Chen: Enablement plan: one Admin + one Developer session, plus exportable runbook. Put Admin session in Week2, Dev deep-dive in Week3. We'll record both.
onboard-bot: Created project folder https://redwood.link/luminary-onboard and scheduled weekly invites (Fri 11am PT). Checklist added. React :thumbsup: when reviewed.
Alex Rivera: Action items: Priya to intro stakeholders, Sam to list firewall + data requirements, Maya to draft enablement dates, Priya to send pulse survey template. Call out any critical blockers by EOD.
Priya Nair: Will intro Ravi/Giselle/Ken in 30m and share the SSO form.
Sam Ortiz: I'll post the dataset schema and firewall checklist by EOD.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone 44d marking kickoff noted; will follow up if any changes.
